competing_explanation: The 30-day window may be outdated, regional, promotional, or limited to specific product categories rather than all standard items.
hypothesis_statement: The current policy provides a 30-day full-refund return window for standard items, measured from delivery or receipt.
refutation_criterion: A current authoritative policy source states a different return window, applies the 30-day window only to non-standard items, or does not provide a full refund within that window.
